scope: CPU feasibility probe after allocator NO-GO; consumed development data only
allocation: uniform; all budget pooled independently within each group, no allocation or reuse tuning
candidate: fixed-half: 0.5*f_epsilon(V); coefficient fixed before this probe's outcomes
controls: oracle-scalar: clipped exact-risk-minimizing scalar in [0,1], knows p
primary_descriptive_estimand: relative reduction of equally weighted six-component mean MSE at total16, all96 consumed vectors; ratios of means
hypothesis: fixed-half achieves material mean reduction without unacceptable regression on high-signal stress cases
rejection_rule: Reject fixed-half as a general follow-up if reduction <=5% at total16 OR nonpositive mean reduction at total8 or32 OR any of six stress regimes at any budget worsens >10% relative to plugin
paths: all27 previously fixed deterministic dispersion probes retained, descriptive only; not included in primary mean
uncertainty: exact reward-state risk; no fresh population interval on consumed data
no_tuning: no scalar sweep, winner selection, estimator switch, distribution change, or confirmation access
